newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil slips with futures, premiums pressured.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil slips with futures, premiums pressured.

text.p: NWE gas oil was knocked $2 a tonne lower on Monday by weaker IPE futures and pressured premiums.
March IPE gas oil closed $2.00 a tonne lower at $167, depressed by crude's weakness.
Heating oil barge trade was slow and premiums lost up to 50 cents with prompt material talked around March IPE flat.
"There's really very little trade happening," said one dealer.
FOD attracted a touch more interest, but sellers' offers were too high for business to be concluded, said one trader.
Premiums were assessed at about $1-2 cif NWE for both first and second half March.
DIN managed to retain a slight premium against FOD with offers heard a touch above April IPE +$3 cif NWE for second half March material.
Diesel cargoes still attracted March IPE +$13-14 cif NWE, although most talk was around April IPE +11-12.
